notes.title: Patch notes
notes.content:
This version (3532932) contains the following fixes:

- Automatically join a friend when clicking their name in the main menu when they have already sent an invite to you.
- (possibly) fixed a crash when closing the game while still connected to another player.

notes.title: Patch notes
notes.content:
This version (3498696) contains the following fixes:

- Added an extra snap turn setting. Moving around should be easier now, especially on oculus.

notes.title: Patch notes
notes.content:
This version (3471150) contains the following fixes:

- Made putting bow on arrow a bit easier
- Fixed arrows going through traffic signs and billboard tiles without hitting them
- Added a list of recently played with players to the main menu (the recently played with page on Steam should also show players but I think steam is broken because it's not working for me)
- Fixed steam invite notifications showing up during a game in the middle of the world
- Added a free locomotion setting in the settings screen
- Added a grabbing stuff with the grip butotn setting in the settings screen

notes.title: Patch notes
notes.content:
This version (3457424) contains the following fixes:

- Added in game friend invite menu, the steam overlay menu sometimes didn't pop up and some people might have the SteamVR dashboard disabled.
- Added in game notification when someone invites you.
- Added bell sound when the game starts.

notes.title: Patch notes
notes.content:
This version (3412297) contains the following fixes:

- Added snap turn
- Fix objects movement glitching when being held by the other player sometimes (especially the überbow in the middle)
- Made the tutorial movement animation more clear
- Made arrows less likely to go straight through traffic signs without hitting them
- Start game in full screen by default

notes.title: Patch notes
notes.content:
This version (3405488) contains the following fixes:

- fix pocket pc being white for some players
- fixed not being able to open Dans drawers
- changed Party Animal achievement requirements
